android.title: Why Cloud Meeting Bots Fail in Real Boardrooms — Building a 3-Hour Screen-Off Offline Meeting Recorder on Android
android.describe: Most modern AI meeting note-takers follow the same pattern: a cloud bot dials into your Zoom or Google Meet call, streams audio to remote servers, and emails a summary afterward.
